aiResearchSummary.text: Mazama appears to be researching systems and processes for stimulating subterranean geologic formations to create an artificial stress barrier and enhancing connectivity and permeability between injector and producer wells using sequenced stimulation in enhanced geothermal systems. They also work on methods of forming a permeable proppant pack in a geothermal formation at high temperature. Together these efforts target geothermal reservoir stimulation, flow connectivity, and high temperature proppant technology.
